page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on KVM virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, it supplies 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). The system is equipped with 32 GB of system memory, yielding a 2 GB per vCPU ratio, 48 MB of L3 cache, and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. It includes no local instance storage and no dedicated GPUs.

The underlying hardware architecture incorporates advanced vector and cryptographic instruction set extensions, including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. Synthetic benchmark evaluations show average middle-tier performance metrics, with a single-core stress-ng rating of 1875.78 and a multi-core score of 15544.16. In Geekbench tests, the instance records 1598.0 in single-core and 9553.0 in multi-core operation, paired with a overall Passmark CPU score of 21125.85. Memory throughput reaches 95.55 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 56.68 GB/sec for large-block writes.

Specialized workload performance metrics demonstrate static web serving throughput of 21.07 GB/sec and Redis SET throughput of 15.82 million operations per second. For small LLM inference (135M parameters), the setup generates 263.14 tokens per second, while a medium 7B parameter model yields 12.52 tokens per second. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio favors pure execution throughput over high-capacity memory retention, offering standard cost efficiency for CPU-bound tasks where large memory allocations are unnecessary. Architectural tradeoffs include the complete absence of local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. Recommended workloads include software compilation, CI/CD automation, web serving, and general CPU-bound processing.
